name: Benchmark_openthought
description: A text-based benchmark focused on measuring models' multi-step and commonsense reasoning abilities on open-ended thought problems. It contains prompts that require inference, explanation, and factual reasoning and evaluates the correctness and quality of generated answers and justifications. Often used to probe reasoning capabilities rather than surface-form language generation.
reputation: A niche research benchmark used in reasoning/model-evaluation studies with limited mainstream adoption.
